highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Seneca Polytechnic, located in Toronto, Canada, is one of the largest and most comprehensive polytechnics in the country. Whether you’re into business, technology, creative arts, health sciences or engineering, it offers a wide range of courses to choose from.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: With several campuses across Toronto, you’ll meet students from all over the world. You can be involved in a lot of student associations, clubs, extracurriculars, and more.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Seneca offers on-campus apartment-style residences and off-campus options, including rentals, private and shared rooms, and homestays.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
Across all Seneca campuses, you’ll find plenty of resources, like books, journals, databases, and even eBooks to support your coursework.

Sports
Seneca has an active sports scene with 15 varsity teams competing in the Ontario Colleges Athletics Association (OCAA) and the Canadian Collegiate Athletics Association (CCAA). You can join teams like badminton, basketball, soccer, rugby, volleyball, and more.

Laboratory
For students in technical programmes such as Engineering, Health Sciences, and IT, Seneca offers specialised lab spaces.

Cafeteria
Seneca’s campuses offer a variety of dining options, including cafeterias, cafés, and food courts. You’ll find a wide range of meals, snacks, and beverages.
